items.text: Career guidance after B.Tech ECE is built for the specific fork Electronics and Communication graduates actually face: core electronics, VLSI and semiconductor design, embedded systems, telecom and networks, or a software role, plus the higher-studies specializations sitting behind each one.

The point is to choose the track tied to a real, high-value skill portfolio instead of whichever branch trend is loudest this placement season, so this stage starts unlocking stronger income opportunities and earlier financial freedom instead of a year lost to a default.
